snapshot.text: Government-led system with a primary-care focus, where households often pay directly for care. The World Bank notes notable progress over the past decade. A 2025-2034 overhaul of care organisation, hospitals and insurance is now being validated.

minister.name: Ibrahima Sy
minister.role: Minister of Health and Public Hygiene

priorities.title: National health system transformation strategy
priorities.text: Authorities have validated a 2025-2034 strategy, costed at about 6,661 billion CFA francs, to reshape hospitals, health districts and gradual compulsory health insurance.

priorities.title: Upgrading health facilities and primary care
priorities.text: The Prime Minister wants medical equipment upgraded under the National Transformation Agenda 2050. The health minister must deliver a rehabilitation plan for facilities and primary care centres.

priorities.title: Pharmaceutical sovereignty for health security
priorities.text: The health minister presented a Council of Ministers communication on pharmaceutical sovereignty as a lever for health security and economic development.

netherlands.text: The Netherlands funds CEPI, which is expanding a vaccine manufacturing network that includes Senegal. This is an indirect link, not a bilateral health programme.
